title: Explicit lifecycle onboarding in a reusable pinned starter
outcomes: Fresh clones select their own lifecycle settings and retain one task workspace across model phases.

in: Released v0.3.26 pin, ordinary/linked runtime discovery, explicit example settings and task intake, reusable smoke and preserved source maintenance history
out: Source template customization into an app
boundaries: Template source remains template; spike customization creates a new .go and drops source maintenance profiles/history; canonical source owns maintenance state

decision_rights: Authorize execution and choose model; GO on 2026-09-13
Implement bounded contract choices and document compatibility behavior

constraints: Keep project_mode template and no execution_defaults. Example settings are explicit inputs, not active defaults.

Only the reusable smoke task is published as open work. Active/pending maintenance tasks remain local; completed records and raw proof are archived as non-executable .go/evidence history. Retain canonical records until dependent source work completes, then archive the completed source queue with its evidence intact. Do not export source run authority into new project onboarding.

Source maintenance uses a read-only local Git-tag verifier (origin/main) with no model or publication defaults; actual hosted release creation/readback is a separate authorized source maintenance action. Spike replaces the source .go when customizing a copied template.
Use exact released stack ref and commit, accept valid .git directories or linked-worktree files, reject mismatched/dirty explicit runtimes without silently resetting user work.
Document explicit model/effort, version source, release target, verification, base/workspace, phase inputs/evidence and optional deployment policy; no inferred execution rights.
No GitHub Actions. Model examples need actual runtime catalog validation.

quality_attributes.scenario: Launch ordinary and linked pinned checkouts
quality_attributes.measure: Accepted mismatched runtime or overwritten user work

quality_attributes.scenario: Configure lifecycle workspace and phase contracts
quality_attributes.measure: Implicit worktree-per-model or canonical worker writes

risks: Example commands/settings need project-specific values and checks before execution.
Template source maintenance planning is local until completed records can be published; archived evidence and releases preserve completed work.
